featured_reviews.review_text:
Ambiance: Simple, soothing, with both indoor and outdoor sitting. Located at Babhai Naka, Borivali.

Our experience: We went in for dinner on a weekday. The place was largely empty and quiet. Took them 20 mins to take our first order despite having only 4 tables being served including ours.

We ordered the following dishes:
• Bombil Fry: The coating was way too thicker and the bombil hardly present. Could barely taste the bombil.
• Prawn koliwada: Again the coating overpowered the flavor of prawns.
• Bangda Thali and Ravas thali: Both thalis were exactly the same with the same fish curry, a tiny serving of prawn preparation, another tiny serving of matki usal in one thali and another random gravy in the bangda thalis. We weren't asked about our preferences for wada, chapati or bhakri. So one thali came with wadas, the other with chapati and on placing the order the third, we were asked about our preference for chapati or bhakri then informed bhakri is probabaly over. So we okayed chapati but were served wadas.

We also ordered another plate of extra chapati which they didnt have and offered wadas but none reached our table even after 2 reminders.

Finally we finished our meals and then asked for the bill which had the extra cost of wadas which we ordered and never recieved and also for the wada in thali which we weren't informed were charged extra but were given as they didnt have chapatis or bhakris.

They did change the bill on being informed.

We also asked for regular water which we recieved almost at the end of the meal after being reminded for the fifth time.

Service: Slow, and confused even when there were just 2-3 tables with people only.

While we understand it was end if the day and hence the food there was over and also probably that is why there were many errors & delays in service. But the overall experience and food were not upto the mark or hype.

A jewel worth your moolah! Nestled in the by-lanes of Borivali, this little gem is a sparkler, for sure. Your search for authentic Malvani cuisine ends here.

Thumbs up!! 👍👌
